known.via: English Wikipedia "Tacoronte-Acentejo" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation on the Anaga Peninsula in northeastern Tenerife. It was the first Canary Islands region to gain DO status, in 1992, and is the largest appellation on Tenerife.
